summary: All four requirements (REQ-12, REQ-13, REQ-14, REQ-15) appear to be fully implemented. The diff includes a complete booking system with backend data models and functions, a frontend booking form with all required fields, service area display for Llano and Burnet counties, and navigation integration with smooth scrolling.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module (backend/migration.mo) for data migration from legacy contact form system
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not mention any requirement for data migration or handling legacy data. This appears to be an implementation detail beyond the specified scope.
REQ-13 specifies functions to retrieve bookings by ID and list all bookings, but does not request filtering by customer name.

hallucinated_features.description: React Query hooks for booking management in useQueries.ts
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not specify the implementation pattern for frontend data fetching. React Query hooks are an implementation detail beyond what was requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Booking ID display in confirmation message
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-12 AC specifies 'User receives confirmation message after successful booking submission' but does not specify that the booking ID should be displayed in the message.
